dialogues.jp:
コツコツと黒板にチョークで文字を書く音が響
き、カリカリとそれをノートに書き写す音が聞
こえる。
dialogues.en:
The scratching of chalk on blackboard was closely mirrored
by the scribbling of pen on note paper.
dialogues.text:
The scratching of chalk on blackboard was closely mirrored
by the scribbling of pen on note paper.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、１箇所だけ書き損ねた内容を見つけたが、
ちょうど先ほど消されたばかりの場所だった。
dialogues.en:
Just as I realized I had miswritten an earlier passage of
text, it was erased from the blackboard.
dialogues.text:
Just as I realized I had miswritten an earlier passage of
text, it was erased from the blackboard.

dialogues.jp:
俺の席のずっと前――教卓のまん前では、音夢
が顔をあげては下を向き、手を動かしている。
dialogues.en:
At the very front of the class, right in front of the
teacher's desk, Nemu had her head down, furiously copying
notes.
dialogues.text:
At the very front of the class, right in front of the
teacher's desk, Nemu had her head down, furiously copying
notes.

dialogues.jp:
このクラスに音夢がいる限り、ノートの心配は
ないな。
dialogues.en: I can just copy them from Nemu later, I suppose.
dialogues.text: I can just copy them from Nemu later, I suppose.

dialogues.jp:
うっかり黒板の文字をノートに書き写し損ねて
しまう。でも、大丈夫。このクラスには音夢が
いる。
dialogues.en:
I didn't manage to write down a passage from the blackboard
before it was erased. But it's still okay. Nemu's in this
class.
dialogues.text:
I didn't manage to write down a passage from the blackboard
before it was erased. But it's still okay. Nemu's in this
class.

dialogues.jp: 音夢がいる限り、ノートの心配はないな。
dialogues.en:
While Nemu's around, there's no need to worry about taking
notes.
dialogues.text:
While Nemu's around, there's no need to worry about taking
notes.
